shortDescription: Configure advanced settings for HTTPS Inspection.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: blocked_certificate_tracking
options.description:
Controls whether to log and send a notification for dropped traffic.
  • None - Does not record the event.
  • Log - Records the event details in SmartView.
  • Alert - Logs the event and executes a command.
  • Mail - Sends an email to the administrator.
  • SNMP Trap - Sends an SNMP alert to the SNMP GU.
  • User Defined Alert - Sends customized alerts.
.

options.name: blocked_certificates
options.description:
Collection of certificates objects identified by serial number.
Drop traffic from servers using the blocked certificate.

options.name: bypass_on_client_failure
options.description:
Whether all requests should be bypassed or blocked-in case of client errors (Client closes the connection due to authentication issues during handshake)
  • true - Fail-open (bypass all requests).
  • false - Fail-close (block all requests.

The default value is true.

options.name: bypass_on_failure
options.description:
Whether all requests should be bypassed or blocked-in case of server errors (for example validation error during GW-Server authentication)
  • true - Fail-open (bypass all requests).
  • false - Fail-close (block all requests.

The default value is true.

options.name: bypass_under_load
options.description: Bypass the HTTPS Inspection temporarily to improve connectivity during a heavy load on the Security Gateway. The HTTPS Inspection would resume as soon as the load decreases.

options.name: bypass_update_services
options.description:
Configure the value "true" to bypass traffic to well-known software update services.
The default value is true.

options.name: certificate_pinned_apps_action
options.description:
Configure the value "bypass" to bypass traffic from certificate-pinned applications approved by Check Point.
HTTPS Inspection cannot inspect connections initiated by certificate-pinned applications.
Configure the value "detect" to send logs for traffic from certificate-pinned applications approved by Check Point.
The default value is bypass.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: domains_to_process
options.description: Indicates which domains to process the commands on. It cannot be used with the details-level full, must be run from the System Domain only and with ignore-warnings true. Valid values are, CURRENT_DOMAIN, ALL_DOMAINS_ON_THIS_SERVER.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: log_sessions
options.description:
The value "true" configures the Security Gateway to send HTTPS Inspection session logs.
The default value is true.

options.name: retrieve_intermediate_ca_certificates
options.description:
Configure the value "true" to use the "Certificate Authority Information Access" extension to retrieve certificates that are missing from the certificate chain.
The default value is true.

options.name: server_certificate_validation_actions
options.description: When a Security Gateway receives an untrusted certificate from a website server, define when to drop the connection and how to track it.

options.name: site_categorization_allow_mode
options.description:
Whether all requests should be allowed or blocked until categorization is complete.
  • Background - to allow requests until categorization is complete.
  • Hold- to block requests until categorization is complete.

The default value is hold.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
